videoTitle: The Borgias Season 1: Official Trailer | SHOWTIME

comments.author: @SirFrederickCF
comments.text: This is the family that inspired Machiavelli to write his classic on politics "The Prince". Here is a family who understood power intimately and knew how to wield it effectively. In an age of intrigue, deceit, passion, treachery, and violence these individuals came close to uniting all of Italy into a kingdom that was divided into rival mafia style territories by the petty ambitions of the Orsinis, the Sforzas, the Viscontis and the Medicis. Showtime has here an excellent recipe for Emmies.
